ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AC=BC$, point $D$ is on side $AC$, and point $E$ is on the extension line of $CB$. $DE$ intersects $AB$ at point $F$. If $\angle C=50^\circ$ and $\angle E=25^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BFE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $AC=BC$, \\
$\therefore \angle A=\angle ABC$, \\
Since $\angle C=50^\circ$, and $\angle A+\angle ABC+\angle C=180^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle ABC= \frac{1}{2}(180^\circ-\angle C)=65^\circ$, \\
Given $\angle E=25^\circ$, and $\angle ABC=\angle E+\angle BFE$, \\
$\therefore \angle BFE=\angle ABC-\angle E=65^\circ-25^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
